meta.title: Perelai in your browser: installing and app stores
meta.description: Perelai runs in a web browser. Installing it is optional and depends on your browser. There is no App Store or Google Play listing.

hero.title: Open Perelai in the browser you already have.
hero.body: Sign in at perelai.app and start working. Installing Perelai is optional and depends on your browser. There is no App Store or Google Play listing.
hero.micro: You'll get a verification email to finish setting up.

showcase.title: One workspace. The view changes with the screen.
showcase.body: Perelai lives at one web address. Open it in a supported browser, sign in, and you are in your workspace — there is no separate version to find for each screen. As the screen gets wider, more of the day stays in view.

installBenefits.title: What changes when it's on your Home Screen
installBenefits.body: On iPhone, add Perelai to your Home Screen and it opens from its own icon, in its own window — no address bar, no tabs. iOS asks whether to open it as a web app; leave that switch on and it opens that way every time.
installBenefits.fallbackBody: Installing is optional. Perelai runs in a supported browser, and that route keeps working whether or not you ever install anything.

guides.title: Where to start
guides.body: The route is the same everywhere: open the address in a supported browser and sign in. Anything after that is optional.

iphone.title: iPhone
iphone.body: Open perelai.app in Safari and sign in. To keep it on your Home Screen: Share, then Add to Home Screen. Perelai shows you the same steps inside the app.

ipad.title: iPad
ipad.body: Open perelai.app in a supported browser and sign in. Same address, same login as elsewhere.

android.title: Android
android.body: Open perelai.app in a supported browser and sign in. Installing anything afterwards is optional.

desktop.title: Laptop and desktop
desktop.body: Open perelai.app in a supported browser and sign in. Installing is optional and not every browser offers it.

embedded.title: Opened from a link inside another app
embedded.body: If a link opens Perelai inside another app's built-in browser, open perelai.app in your usual supported browser instead and sign in.

limitations.title: What to expect
limitations.installVaries: Whether a browser offers to install Perelai depends on the browser and the device. Some browsers do not offer it at all, and Perelai does not need it.
limitations.noStore: There is no App Store or Google Play listing.
limitations.browserDecides: This page describes the general route. Your own browser decides which install option, if any, it offers you.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Does Perelai have an iPhone or Android app?
faq.a1: Perelai is booking, client and money software for independent service professionals. Perelai is not listed on the App Store or on Google Play; it runs in a web browser at perelai.app instead. Installing Perelai from a browser is optional and not offered by every browser. Perelai needs an internet connection.
faq.q2: Can I use Perelai without installing anything?
faq.a2: Yes. Perelai runs in a supported web browser. Sign in at perelai.app and work there — installing is optional and never required.
faq.q3: Can I use Perelai on an iPad?
faq.a3: Open perelai.app in a supported browser on the tablet and sign in with the same login you use elsewhere. One login, one workspace. An internet connection is required.
faq.q4: Can I use Perelai on a laptop or desktop?
faq.a4: Open perelai.app in a supported browser and sign in with the same login you use elsewhere. One login, one workspace. An internet connection is required.
faq.q5: Why don't I see an option to install Perelai?
faq.a5: Browsers decide that, not Perelai. Some browsers offer to add a site to a home screen or open it in a window of its own, and others never do. Perelai does not require it either way.
faq.a6: No. Perelai needs an internet connection.
